name: cockpit
description: Operational side panel and a more readable chat for Claude Code in the terminal, OpenCode-inspired look

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: Colours: dark or light for the terminal background, or a theme: nord, high-contrast, colorblind (Okabe-Ito, no red/green pairs)

proseWidth.title: Text width
proseWidth.description: Wrap reply text at this column (40 or more); 0 uses the whole chat width

panelWidth.title: Panel width
panelWidth.description: Columns of the side panel (24 or more, e.g. 32 for a compact panel on a wide screen); 0 lets Claude Code decide

hiddenSections.title: Hidden sections
hiddenSections.description: Panel sections to hide, comma separated: aside, mcp, running, search, sessions, pipelines, where, model, modes, context, pr, tasks, actions, delegation, writes, reminders, files

prodPattern.title: Production pattern
prodPattern.description: Regular expression that marks a subscription, kubectl context or branch as production (case-insensitive; noprod and nonprod never match)

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the panel when a session starts

inlineCodeColor.title: Inline code colour
inlineCodeColor.description: Colour of `inline code` in replies, as #rrggbb; empty uses the palette's

adoProjects.title: Azure DevOps projects
adoProjects.description: Projects whose pipeline runs to show, comma separated as org/project (the current repo's and those named in commands are added by themselves)

pipelinesShow.title: Pipelines shown
pipelinesShow.description: active-failed: only running, queued, waiting for approval and failed runs; all: every run of the last 24 hours

pipelinesMax.title: Pipelines max
pipelinesMax.description: How many pipeline runs the panel shows at most

localModels.title: Local model servers
localModels.description: OpenAI-compatible servers whose models delegation may use through OpenCode, comma separated (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp, on this PC or the private network)
